# Configuration reference (schema v5)

<!-- Generated by kurashi_schema::docs_markdown — do not edit by hand. -->

Keys are flat and dotted; in `config.toml` the last segment is the key and the rest is the table (`bar.height` → `[bar] height = …`). Per-output keys may also be set under `[outputs."<name>".<table>]`.

## Layout

### Layout

#### `layout.draw` — Draw mode

How the bars, the dock, the sidebars and the island meet the screen's edges and each other. Floating: a gap away from everything, every corner rounded, with the look's shadow. Dynamic: flush on the edge (or the frame, or a bar), joined to it by rounded fillets. Connected: flush and joined with straight corners. A component set to its own mode keeps it.

- type: `choice` · default: `"dynamic"`
- choices: `"floating"` | `"dynamic"` | `"connected"`
- since schema v3

#### `layout.reveal_delay` — Reveal delay

How long the pointer rests on an edge before what shows on hover comes out; an edge another screen touches waits twice as long.

- type: `int` · default: `250`
- range: `0..=1000`, step `50` (ms)
- since schema v3

#### `bar.height` — Bar height

Thickness of every bar in logical pixels (its width on a left or right edge), and of an edge's modules.

- type: `int` · default: `32`
- range: `16..=96`, step `2` (px)
- per-output

### Frame

#### `layout.frame.enabled` — Screen frame

A band round the screen that the bars, the dock and the sidebars stand on, its inner corners rounded.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`
- per-output
- since schema v3

#### `layout.frame.thickness` — Frame thickness

- type: `int` · default: `8`
- range: `2..=32`, step `1` (px)
- only while `layout.frame.enabled == true`
- since schema v3

#### `layout.frame.reserve` — Windows keep clear of the frame

Windows tile inside the frame. Off: the frame is drawn over the windows' edges.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- only while `layout.frame.enabled == true`
- since schema v3

### Top edge

#### `edges.top.bar` — Bar

A bar stands on this edge and shows its modules. Without one, each part that lists modules shows them on their own at the edge.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- per-output
- since schema v3

#### `edges.top.visibility` — Visibility

Always shown; shown when the pointer rests on the edge; shown while the desktop is empty, else on hover; or hidden until a key, the command line or `layout.toggle` brings it out.

- type: `choice` · default: `"always"`
- choices: `"always"` | `"hover"` | `"empty_desktop"` | `"hidden"`
- per-output
- since schema v3

#### `edges.top.reserve` — Keep space

Whether windows keep clear of it. Automatic keeps space only while it is always shown; Always keeps it while it hides on hover too.

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"on"` | `"off"`
- only while `edges.top.visibility != "hidden"`
- per-output
- since schema v3

#### `edges.top.draw` — Draw mode

Automatic follows the layout's draw mode.

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"floating"` | `"dynamic"` | `"connected"`
- per-output
- since schema v3

#### `edges.top.start` — Start

The modules at the start of the edge (the left, or the top of a side edge), in order. "Other mods' widgets" stands for every mod widget no list names.

- type: `string_list` · default: `["sidebar_left", "workspaces", "windows"]`
- choices: from `modules` (resolved at runtime)
- per-output
- since schema v3

#### `edges.top.center` — Centre

The modules in the middle of the edge, in order.

- type: `string_list` · default: `["island"]`
- choices: from `modules` (resolved at runtime)
- per-output
- since schema v3

#### `edges.top.end` — End

The modules at the end of the edge (the right, or the bottom of a side edge), in order.

- type: `string_list` · default: `["volume", "mods", "recorder", "keyboard", "clock", "quick", "tray", "sidebar_right"]`
- choices: from `modules` (resolved at runtime)
- per-output
- since schema v3

## Appearance

### Colors

#### `theme.style` — Style

A fixed preset that recreates one aesthetic: a look, a palette, the scheme, density and motion. Applying a style resets your appearance changes; what you change afterwards shows as a difference from it. It changes how things look, never where they are (K53).

- type: `string` · default: `"washi"`
- choices: from `styles` (resolved at runtime)

#### `theme.look` — Look

The form and feel of the interface without its colours: chrome, corners, material, motion, type and its art — sekai's toy keycaps, washi's paper and ink, win95's bevels. The style picks one; pick another to override it (K53).

- type: `string` · default: `"kanso"`
- choices: from `looks` (resolved at runtime)

#### `theme.colors.palette` — Palette

Colours only: the roles every surface is painted with, in light and dark. A style picks one; pick another to override it (K53).

- type: `string` · default: `"wa-iro"`
- choices: from `palettes` (resolved at runtime)

#### `theme.colors.scheme` — Light or dark

Every palette has both. Follow the system's preference, the wallpaper's brightness, or pick one. Applying a style makes it follow the style; "Back to …" returns to your own choice (K55).

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"wallpaper"` | `"dark"` | `"light"`

#### `theme.colors.contrast` — Contrast

Raises the contrast between surfaces and text.

- type: `choice` · default: `"standard"`
- choices: `"standard"` | `"medium"` | `"high"`
- forced to `"high"` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

#### `theme.colors.colorblind` — Colour-blind adjustment

Shifts accent colours so they stay distinguishable.

- type: `choice` · default: `"none"`
- choices: `"none"` | `"protanopia"` | `"deuteranopia"` | `"tritanopia"`

#### `theme.colors.season` — Seasonal tint (旬)

The colours lean a little toward the season's own — winter blue, sakura, fresh green, maple — following the 24 solar terms.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`
- advanced

#### `theme.colors.oled` — Pure black (OLED)

Pure-black grounds on dark schemes.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`
- only while `theme.colors.scheme != "light"`

#### `theme.colors.ink` — Text colour

The colour of text and icons: the palette's own, or an ink — each with a shade for light and for dark — or a colour of your own. It is kept legible on every surface; the theme notes say when it had to be adjusted (K60).

- type: `choice` · default: `"palette"`
- choices: `"palette"` | `"blue"` | `"black"` | `"sepia"` | `"red"` | `"green"` | `"violet"` | `"custom"`

#### `theme.colors.ink_custom` — Your text colour

Used in light and dark alike, adjusted only as far as legibility needs.

- type: `color` · default: `"#2b4a8b"`
- only while `theme.colors.ink == "custom"`

#### `theme.export` — Apps that follow

Write the shell's colours for these apps whenever the theme changes: GTK, Qt, terminals, niri (K49). Each one needs one line in its own config to read the file; Settings shows it.

- type: `string_list` · default: `[]`
- choices: from `theme.export` (resolved at runtime)

#### `theme.icon_theme` — Icons for apps

The icon theme the apps that follow use (GTK, Qt, KDE), written with their colours. "Leave as is" keeps each app's own choice (I183).

- type: `string` · default: `""`
- choices: from `icon_themes` (resolved at runtime)

### Shape

#### `theme.shape.corners` — Corners

Corner style of bars, popups and the island.

- type: `choice` · default: `"rounded"`
- choices: `"none"` | `"rounded"` | `"squircle"`

#### `theme.shape.screen_corners_follow` — Screen corners follow the radius

The screen's corners take the corner radius, so the frame, the bars and the panels sit concentric in them (a square look leaves them square). Off: they take their own size below.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- since schema v5

#### `theme.shape.screen_corners` — Screen corners

Rounds the corners of every screen by this many pixels (0 = square, as the panel is).

- type: `int` · default: `0`
- range: `0..=48`, step `2` (px)
- only while `theme.shape.screen_corners_follow == false`

#### `theme.shape.radius` — Corner radius

The one radius every corner follows (K74): panels, cards and the island's views take it; buttons, toggles and smaller parts take steps of it; the frame's inner corners and the joins of the bar, the dock and the sidebars take it less the frame's thickness, so curves that sit inside one another stay concentric.

- type: `int` · default: `18`
- range: `0..=48`, step `1` (px)
- only while `theme.shape.corners != "none"`
- since schema v4

#### `theme.chrome` — Chrome

How blocks are drawn: flat fills; keycaps with an ink outline, a light ring and a hard shadow they sink into when pressed; soft blocks with a faint rim and a soft shadow; or ink lines (K42, K45).

- type: `choice` · default: `"flat"`
- choices: `"flat"` | `"keycap"` | `"soft"` | `"line"`
- forced to `"flat"` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

### Material

#### `theme.material.kind` — Material

Surface material of shell chrome.

- type: `choice` · default: `"translucent"`
- choices: `"solid"` | `"translucent"` | `"glass"`
- forced to `"solid"` while `a11y.reduce_transparency` is on
- forced to `"solid"` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

#### `theme.material.opacity` — Opacity

Opacity of translucent and glass surfaces.

- type: `float` · default: `0.85`
- range: `0.3..=1.0`, step `0.01`
- only while `theme.material.kind != "solid"`
- forced to `1.0` while `a11y.reduce_transparency` is on

#### `theme.material.blur` — Background blur

Blur what is behind glass surfaces. Forced off when the compositor cannot blur.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- only while `theme.material.kind == "glass"`
- needs compositor capability `blur`
- forced to `false` while `a11y.reduce_transparency` is on

#### `theme.material.shadow` — Shadows

How strong the shadows under blocks and surfaces are: 0 draws none, 1 is the look's own, 2 twice as long and dark.

- type: `float` · default: `1.0`
- range: `0.0..=2.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.chrome != "flat"`
- only while `theme.chrome != "line"`

#### `theme.material.shadow_angle` — Shadow direction

Where shadows fall, in degrees round the screen: 180 straight down, 135 down to the right.

- type: `int` · default: `180`
- range: `0..=359`, step `1` (°)
- only while `theme.material.shadow_follow == false`
- only while `theme.chrome != "flat"`
- only while `theme.chrome != "line"`

#### `theme.material.shadow_follow` — Shadows follow the light

Shadows fall away from the material's light, longer when it stands low. A light that follows the pointer casts them from where it rests, so they never move with the pointer.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`
- only while `theme.chrome != "flat"`
- only while `theme.chrome != "line"`

### Motion

#### `theme.motion.profile` — Motion

Character of animations: expressive (surfaces grow out of the edge on timed curves that overshoot a little), calm or lively (springs), or none at all.

- type: `choice` · default: `"expressive"`
- choices: `"expressive"` | `"calm"` | `"lively"` | `"none"`
- forced to `"none"` while `a11y.reduce_motion` is on

#### `theme.motion.speed` — Animation speed

Multiplies every motion duration's speed (2.0 = twice as fast).

- type: `float` · default: `1.0`
- range: `0.25..=3.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.motion.profile != "none"`
- advanced

### Layout

#### `theme.density` — Density

Scales spacing and control sizes everywhere.

- type: `choice` · default: `"regular"`
- choices: `"compact"` | `"regular"` | `"airy"`

### Typography

#### `theme.typography.family` — Font family

Fallback chain; the first installed family wins (resolved via fontconfig).

- type: `font` · default: `["Inter", "Noto Sans CJK JP", "sans-serif"]`

#### `theme.typography.family_jp` — Japanese font family

Fallback chain for Japanese text; the first installed family wins (K60).

- type: `font` · default: `["Noto Sans CJK JP", "Noto Sans JP", "IPAexGothic", "sans-serif"]`
- advanced

#### `theme.typography.scale` — Text scale

Multiplies every type size token.

- type: `float` · default: `1.0`
- range: `0.75..=2.0`, step `0.05`
- forced to `1.25` while `a11y.large_text` is on

### Texture

#### `theme.texture.kind` — Material

A relief the shell is made of — paper, fabric, stone, metal, leather, wood, brushed oil paint. It adds light and shade from the light below, never colours of its own (K59).

- type: `choice` · default: `"none"`
- choices: `"none"` | `"paper"` | `"paper_dots"` | `"paper_lines"` | `"paper_grid"` | `"fabric"` | `"wool"` | `"stone"` | `"halftone"` | `"metal"` | `"leather"` | `"wood"` | `"paint"` | `"brush"`
- forced to `"none"` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on
- forced to `"none"` while `a11y.reduce_transparency` is on

#### `theme.texture.scope` — Where

The shell's surfaces, the wallpaper (baked into the picture), both, or an overlay over everything, apps included — that one costs a full-screen layer, shows in screenshots and keeps fullscreen apps from the fastest path to the screen.

- type: `choice` · default: `"shell"`
- choices: `"shell"` | `"wallpaper"` | `"shell_wallpaper"` | `"everything"`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.strength` — Strength

How strongly the relief reads; past 1 it is strong. Under text it is capped so text stays legible.

- type: `float` · default: `0.5`
- range: `0.0..=2.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.depth` — Depth

How steep the relief is: deeper grain, threads and rulings, with longer shadows when the light is low.

- type: `float` · default: `1.0`
- range: `0.5..=3.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.shadows` — Relief shadows

Grain, threads and rulings cast short shadows away from the light, longer when the light is low. Auto: on for materials with real height (oil paint, brush strokes) and for styles that ask for it.

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"off"` | `"on"`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.scale` — Scale

The size of the material's grain, weave or rulings.

- type: `float` · default: `1.0`
- range: `0.5..=3.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.wrinkles` — Wrinkles

Crumples the material: folds and creases, as in crumpled paper or creased leather.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.cracks` — Cracks

Breaks the material: a network of fine cracks, as in old stone or broken glass.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.crack_style` — Crack pattern

Stone: jagged, branching cracks. Glass: straight-edged shards.

- type: `choice` · default: `"stone"`
- choices: `"stone"` | `"glass"`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.tint` — Ink and colour

Print the rulings, dots and grain in faint colours of the palette. Off: relief only — rulings are pressed into the sheet, nothing is coloured.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.text` — Texture over text

Let the relief run through text and icons too, as ink sinks into paper or is pressed into leather. Off keeps them crisp on the material.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.controls` — Texture over controls

Let the relief run over buttons, sliders, switches and icons too, so the material reads through the whole interface. Pictures — album covers, wallpapers, avatars — stay untouched.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.sheet` — Sheet

How the material sits on surfaces that move. Carried: a panel takes its texture along as it slides or grows and lands on the one continuous sheet. Fixed: the sheet stays put and surfaces slide over it. Separate: every surface is a sheet of its own.

- type: `choice` · default: `"carried"`
- choices: `"carried"` | `"fixed"` | `"separate"`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.texture.wallpaper.own` — Own material for the wallpaper

Give the wallpaper a material of its own instead of the shell's (it is baked into the picture).

- type: `bool` · default: `false`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "shell"`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "everything"`

#### `theme.texture.wallpaper.kind` — Wallpaper material

The relief baked into the wallpaper.

- type: `choice` · default: `"paper"`
- choices: `"none"` | `"paper"` | `"paper_dots"` | `"paper_lines"` | `"paper_grid"` | `"fabric"` | `"wool"` | `"stone"` | `"halftone"` | `"metal"` | `"leather"` | `"wood"` | `"paint"` | `"brush"`
- only while `theme.texture.wallpaper.own == true`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "shell"`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "everything"`

#### `theme.texture.wallpaper.strength` — Wallpaper strength

How strongly the wallpaper's relief reads.

- type: `float` · default: `0.5`
- range: `0.0..=2.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.texture.wallpaper.own == true`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "shell"`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "everything"`

#### `theme.texture.wallpaper.scale` — Wallpaper scale

The size of the wallpaper material's grain.

- type: `float` · default: `1.0`
- range: `0.5..=3.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.texture.wallpaper.own == true`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "shell"`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "everything"`

#### `theme.texture.wallpaper.wrinkles` — Wallpaper wrinkles

Crumples the wallpaper's material.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.texture.wallpaper.own == true`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "shell"`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "everything"`

#### `theme.texture.wallpaper.cracks` — Wallpaper cracks

Cracks in the wallpaper's material (the pattern is the shell's).

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- only while `theme.texture.wallpaper.own == true`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "shell"`
- only while `theme.texture.scope != "everything"`

### Light

#### `theme.light.mode` — Light

Where the material's light comes from: a fixed direction, a lamp at the pointer (over the shell's surfaces; elsewhere it rests at the fixed direction), the sun of the day — sunrise from the left, sunset from the right, warm when it is low — the wallpaper's own light: a lamp at its brightest place, in its colour (K59) — or a spotlight: a lamp pinned at the screen's edge in the light's direction, its beam aimed at the pointer (K61).

- type: `choice` · default: `"static"`
- choices: `"static"` | `"pointer"` | `"daytime"` | `"wallpaper"` | `"spotlight"`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.light.angle` — Direction

Where the fixed light comes from, in degrees round the screen: 0 from the top, 90 from the right, 315 from the top left.

- type: `int` · default: `315`
- range: `0..=359`, step `1` (°)
- only while `theme.light.mode != "daytime"`

#### `theme.light.elevation` — Height

How high the light stands over the screen: low light makes long shadows and a deeper relief.

- type: `int` · default: `40`
- range: `10..=80`, step `1` (°)
- only while `theme.light.mode != "daytime"`

#### `theme.light.beam` — Beam width

How wide the spotlight's beam is: narrow lights a small pool round the pointer, wide most of the screen.

- type: `int` · default: `35`
- range: `10..=80`, step `1` (°)
- only while `theme.light.mode == "spotlight"`

#### `theme.light.color` — Light colour

The colour of the light's highlights. Natural: white, the sun's own, or the wallpaper's.

- type: `choice` · default: `"natural"`
- choices: `"natural"` | `"white"` | `"warm"` | `"cool"` | `"custom"`
- only while `theme.texture.kind != "none"`

#### `theme.light.color_custom` — Your light colour

The highlights' colour.

- type: `color` · default: `"#ffd9a0"`
- only while `theme.light.color == "custom"`

### Pen

#### `theme.pen.line` — Outline

How outlines round blocks and surfaces are drawn: solid, dotted, dashed, broken — long strokes with gaps where the pen left the paper — or rough, a very uneven hand line.

- type: `choice` · default: `"solid"`
- choices: `"solid"` | `"dotted"` | `"dashed"` | `"broken"` | `"rough"`
- forced to `"solid"` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

#### `theme.pen.pressure` — Pen pressure

Outlines swell and thin along their length, as with a fountain pen.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- forced to `0.0` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

#### `theme.pen.breaks` — Skips

The pen skips now and then: small gaps in the outlines.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- forced to `0.0` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

#### `theme.pen.fade` — Ink flow

The ink runs thinner in places: the outlines' opacity varies along them.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- forced to `0.0` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

#### `theme.pen.wobble` — Hand

Straight lines and curves wander a little, as if drawn by hand.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- forced to `0.0` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

#### `theme.pen.text_pressure` — Text: pen pressure

Letters and icons swell and thin, as written with a fountain pen.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- forced to `0.0` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

#### `theme.pen.text_breaks` — Text: skips

Small breaks in letters and icons where the pen skipped.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- forced to `0.0` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

#### `theme.pen.text_fade` — Text: ink flow

Letters and icons vary a little in opacity, as ink does.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- forced to `0.0` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

#### `theme.pen.text_wobble` — Text: hand

Letters and icons wander a little off the straight line, as if written by hand.

- type: `float` · default: `0.0`
- range: `0.0..=1.0`, step `0.05`
- forced to `0.0` while `a11y.high_contrast` is on

### Settings app

#### `settings.window` — Settings opens as

A normal window the compositor places and tiles, or a sheet the shell draws in the middle of the screen over a dimmed desktop — made of the shell's material and lit by its light, like every shell surface.

- type: `choice` · default: `"window"`
- choices: `"window"` | `"sheet"`

## Accessibility

### Modes

#### `a11y.reduce_motion` — Reduce motion

Turns animations off (forces the motion profile to none).

- type: `bool` · default: `false`

#### `a11y.reduce_transparency` — Reduce transparency

Makes every surface solid and disables blur.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`

#### `a11y.high_contrast` — High contrast

Solid surfaces and a high-contrast palette.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`

#### `a11y.large_text` — Large text

Raises the text scale to 125 %.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`

## Island

### Main

#### `island.main.faces` — Faces

Faces this island may show, in cycling order.

- type: `string_list` · default: `["clock", "media", "notifications"]`
- choices: from `island.faces` (resolved at runtime)

#### `island.main.default` — Default face

Face shown when nothing more relevant is happening.

- type: `string` · default: `"clock"`
- choices: from `island.faces` (resolved at runtime)

#### `island.main.ttl` — Transient duration

How long a transient face (volume, brightness, notification) stays before falling back.

- type: `int` · default: `5`
- range: `1..=60` (s)

#### `island.main.system_events` — System events

Volume, brightness, power and Bluetooth changes show on the island for a moment. Off, the island does not listen to them at all.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`

#### `island.main.draw` — Draw mode

How the island meets the bar or the edge it grows out of. Automatic follows the layout's draw mode (K71).

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"floating"` | `"dynamic"` | `"connected"`
- since schema v3

#### `island.main.input.left` — Left click

- type: `action` · default: `"island.expand"`
- choices: from `actions` (resolved at runtime)
- advanced

#### `island.main.input.right` — Right click

- type: `action` · default: `"island.pin"`
- choices: from `actions` (resolved at runtime)
- advanced

#### `island.main.input.middle` — Middle click

- type: `action` · default: `""`
- choices: from `actions` (resolved at runtime)
- advanced

#### `island.main.input.hover` — Hover

- type: `action` · default: `""`
- choices: from `actions` (resolved at runtime)
- advanced

#### `island.main.input.scroll_up` — Scroll up

- type: `action` · default: `"island.prev"`
- choices: from `actions` (resolved at runtime)
- advanced

#### `island.main.input.scroll_down` — Scroll down

- type: `action` · default: `"island.next"`
- choices: from `actions` (resolved at runtime)
- advanced

#### `island.main.input.shift_scroll_up` — Shift + scroll up

- type: `action` · default: `""`
- choices: from `actions` (resolved at runtime)
- advanced

#### `island.main.input.shift_scroll_down` — Shift + scroll down

- type: `action` · default: `""`
- choices: from `actions` (resolved at runtime)
- advanced

### Clock

#### `clock.week_start` — First day of the week

The calendar's first column; automatic follows the language (Sunday for Japanese, Monday otherwise).

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"monday"` | `"sunday"` | `"saturday"`

#### `clock.week_numbers` — Week numbers

Show ISO week numbers beside the calendar's rows.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`

## Notifications

### Server

#### `notifications.server` — Notification server

Receive desktop notifications. Never takes over from another running notification daemon.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- restart required

#### `notifications.dnd` — Do not disturb

Store notifications silently; critical ones still show.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`

#### `notifications.history_max` — History size

How many notifications are kept.

- type: `int` · default: `200`
- range: `10..=2000`, step `10`
- restart required
- advanced

## Launcher

### Apps

#### `launcher.terminal` — Terminal command

Prefix for apps that need a terminal, e.g. foot -e.

- type: `string_list` · default: `["foot", "-e"]`
- restart required

#### `launcher.systemd_scope` — Separate app scopes

Start apps in their own systemd scope so they outlive the shell.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- restart required
- advanced

#### `launcher.web_search` — Web search

The address a query is searched at, `{}` standing for the query; empty = no web search row.

- type: `string` · default: `"https://duckduckgo.com/?q={}"`

## Desktop

### Widgets

#### `desktop.enabled` — Desktop widgets

Cards on the desktop under your windows: the clock, the month, what is playing, the weather.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`
- per-output

#### `desktop.side` — Side

The screen side the cards stand on.

- type: `choice` · default: `"right"`
- choices: `"left"` | `"right"`
- only while `desktop.enabled == true`
- per-output

#### `desktop.clock` — Clock

The time in big keys, with the date.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- only while `desktop.enabled == true`

#### `desktop.calendar` — Calendar

This month, today marked.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- only while `desktop.enabled == true`

#### `desktop.media` — Now playing

The song that plays, with its controls; hidden while nothing plays.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- only while `desktop.enabled == true`

#### `desktop.weather` — Weather

Today's weather, while the weather mod is on and has a place.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- only while `desktop.enabled == true`

#### `desktop.right` — Cards on the right

The cards on the right side from top to bottom: `clock`, `calendar`, `media`, `weather`, and mods' cards as `mod:<id>:<name>`. On the side the cards stand on, a card neither side lists comes after the listed ones. The desk's edit mode writes it (K48, K71).

- type: `string_list` · default: `["clock", "calendar", "media", "weather"]`
- only while `desktop.enabled == true`
- advanced
- since schema v3

#### `desktop.left` — Cards on the left

The cards on the left side from top to bottom, named as on the right.

- type: `string_list` · default: `[]`
- only while `desktop.enabled == true`
- advanced
- since schema v3

#### `desktop.hidden` — Hidden cards

Cards the desk leaves out, named as on either side. The desk's edit mode writes it.

- type: `string_list` · default: `[]`
- only while `desktop.enabled == true`
- advanced

## Power

### Idle

#### `idle.enabled` — Idle actions

Dim, lock, turn the screens off and suspend after a time without input. Apps that play video or calls that are on keep the screen awake (they inhibit idle).

- type: `bool` · default: `true`

#### `idle.dim_after` — Dim after

Lowers the brightness a little before locking. 0 = never.

- type: `int` · default: `240`
- range: `0..=7200`, step `30` (s)
- only while `idle.enabled == true`

#### `idle.lock_after` — Lock after

0 = never.

- type: `int` · default: `300`
- range: `0..=7200`, step `30` (s)
- only while `idle.enabled == true`

#### `idle.screen_off_after` — Screens off after

0 = never.

- type: `int` · default: `600`
- range: `0..=7200`, step `30` (s)
- only while `idle.enabled == true`

#### `idle.suspend_after` — Suspend after

0 = never.

- type: `int` · default: `0`
- range: `0..=14400`, step `60` (s)
- only while `idle.enabled == true`

#### `idle.inhibit_while_media` — Stay awake while media plays

Music or video that plays keeps the screen on.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- only while `idle.enabled == true`

### Night light

#### `night_light.enabled` — Night light

Warmer colours in the evening (wlsunset). Off by default.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`

#### `night_light.temperature` — Warmth

Colour temperature at night; lower is warmer.

- type: `int` · default: `4000`
- range: `1500..=6500`, step `100` (K)
- only while `night_light.enabled == true`

#### `night_light.schedule` — Schedule

When the night colours are on. Sunset to sunrise needs the weather mod's place.

- type: `choice` · default: `"manual"`
- choices: `"always"` | `"manual"` | `"sun"`
- only while `night_light.enabled == true`

#### `night_light.start` — From

Start of the night colours, as HH:MM.

- type: `string` · default: `"20:00"`
- only while `night_light.schedule == "manual"`

#### `night_light.end` — Until

End of the night colours, as HH:MM.

- type: `string` · default: `"07:00"`
- only while `night_light.schedule == "manual"`

### Recorder

#### `recorder.directory` — Folder

Where recordings are saved; empty = your Videos folder.

- type: `string` · default: `""`

#### `recorder.audio` — Record sound

The desktop's sound goes into the recording.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`

#### `recorder.backend` — Recorder

The program that records; automatic takes the first one installed.

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"gpu_screen_recorder"` | `"wf_recorder"`
- advanced

## Dock

### Dock

#### `dock.enabled` — App dock

Your pinned apps and the running ones, at a screen edge.

- type: `bool` · default: `false`
- per-output

#### `dock.edge` — Edge

- type: `choice` · default: `"bottom"`
- choices: `"bottom"` | `"top"` | `"left"` | `"right"`
- only while `dock.enabled == true`
- per-output

#### `dock.visibility` — Visibility

Shown while the desktop is empty and else when the pointer rests on its edge (as before), always, on hover only, or hidden until a key or `layout.toggle` brings it out (K71).

- type: `choice` · default: `"empty_desktop"`
- choices: `"always"` | `"hover"` | `"empty_desktop"` | `"hidden"`
- only while `dock.enabled == true`
- since schema v3

#### `dock.reserve` — Keep space

Whether windows keep clear of the dock. Automatic keeps space only while it is always shown.

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"on"` | `"off"`
- only while `dock.enabled == true`
- only while `dock.visibility != "hidden"`
- since schema v3

#### `dock.draw` — Draw mode

Automatic follows the layout's draw mode.

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"floating"` | `"dynamic"` | `"connected"`
- only while `dock.enabled == true`
- since schema v3

#### `dock.pinned` — Pinned apps

Desktop entry ids (e.g. firefox, org.gnome.Nautilus), in order. Right-click an app in the dock to pin it.

- type: `string_list` · default: `[]`
- only while `dock.enabled == true`

#### `dock.icon_size` — Icon size

- type: `int` · default: `44`
- range: `24..=96`, step `2` (px)
- only while `dock.enabled == true`

#### `dock.show_running` — Running apps

Apps with windows that are not pinned show after the pinned ones.

- type: `bool` · default: `true`
- only while `dock.enabled == true`

## Sidebar

### Right sidebar

#### `sidebar.right.sections` — Sections

Top to bottom: you and the session, the quick tiles, the levels, notifications, the month, what plays, and the mods' panels.

- type: `string_list` · default: `["header", "toggles", "sliders", "notifications", "calendar"]`
- choices: from `sidebar.sections` (resolved at runtime)
- since schema v3

#### `sidebar.right.width` — Width

Drag the sidebar's inner edge to change it.

- type: `int` · default: `420`
- range: `320..=640`, step `10` (px)
- since schema v3

#### `sidebar.right.visibility` — Visibility

Hidden: opened by its key, its button in the bar or `sidebar.toggle`. On hover: rest the pointer on the screen's side. Always shown: pinned open, the windows beside it.

- type: `choice` · default: `"hidden"`
- choices: `"always"` | `"hover"` | `"empty_desktop"` | `"hidden"`
- since schema v3

#### `sidebar.right.reserve` — Keep space

Whether windows keep clear of it. Automatic keeps space only while it is pinned open.

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"on"` | `"off"`
- only while `sidebar.right.visibility != "hidden"`
- since schema v3

#### `sidebar.right.draw` — Draw mode

Dynamic: from the bar (or the screen edge) to the far edge, flush to its side, joined to the bar by rounded fillets. Floating: a gap away from every edge, every corner rounded, with the look's shadow. Automatic follows the layout's draw mode.

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"floating"` | `"dynamic"` | `"connected"`
- since schema v3

### Left sidebar

#### `sidebar.left.sections` — Tabs

The mods' panels (AI chat, tasks, …). A tab whose mod is not on is skipped. Empty: no left sidebar.

- type: `string_list` · default: `["mod:ai:ai"]`
- choices: from `sidebar.tabs` (resolved at runtime)
- since schema v3

#### `sidebar.left.width` — Width

Drag the sidebar's inner edge to change it.

- type: `int` · default: `420`
- range: `320..=640`, step `10` (px)
- since schema v3

#### `sidebar.left.visibility` — Visibility

Hidden: opened by its key, its button in the bar or `sidebar.toggle`. On hover: rest the pointer on the screen's side. Always shown: pinned open, the windows beside it.

- type: `choice` · default: `"hidden"`
- choices: `"always"` | `"hover"` | `"empty_desktop"` | `"hidden"`
- since schema v3

#### `sidebar.left.reserve` — Keep space

Whether windows keep clear of it. Automatic keeps space only while it is pinned open.

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"on"` | `"off"`
- only while `sidebar.left.visibility != "hidden"`
- since schema v3

#### `sidebar.left.draw` — Draw mode

Dynamic: from the bar (or the screen edge) to the far edge, flush to its side, joined to the bar by rounded fillets. Floating: a gap away from every edge, every corner rounded, with the look's shadow. Automatic follows the layout's draw mode.

- type: `choice` · default: `"auto"`
- choices: `"auto"` | `"floating"` | `"dynamic"` | `"connected"`
- since schema v3

### Sidebar

#### `sidebar.from_bar` — Open from the bar

The bar's quick settings button opens the right sidebar instead of the quick settings card (and the bar leaves the right sidebar's own button out).

- type: `bool` · default: `false`

## Keys

### Shortcuts

- type: `bool` · default: `false`

- only while `keys.write == true`

#### `keys.session_menu` — Session menu

- only while `keys.write == true`

#### `keys.lock` — Lock the screen

- type: `string` · default: `"Super+Alt+L"`
- only while `keys.write == true`

#### `keys.settings` — Settings

- type: `string` · default: `""`
- only while `keys.write == true`

#### `keys.webdock` — Web dock

- type: `string` · default: `""`
- only while `keys.write == true`

#### `keys.bar_top` — Top bar

- type: `string` · default: `""`
- only while `keys.write == true`

#### `keys.bar_bottom` — Bottom bar

- type: `string` · default: `""`
- only while `keys.write == true`

#### `keys.bar_left` — Left bar

- type: `string` · default: `""`
- only while `keys.write == true`

#### `keys.bar_right` — Right bar

- type: `string` · default: `""`
- only while `keys.write == true`

#### `keys.dock` — Dock

- type: `string` · default: `""`
- only while `keys.write == true`

#### `keys.volume_up` — Volume up

#### `keys.volume_down` — Volume down
